title: EDOT React Native configuration
description: elastic-otel-config.json at the React Native project root. The native bridge validates the file at startup.

$schema.description: Schema reference for editor support. The bridge ignores it.

exportUrl.description: OTLP base URL with an http or https scheme, without a query, fragment, or /v1/<signal> suffix.

apiKey.description: API key sent with every export request. Omit it when the endpoint needs no authentication.

serviceVersion.description: The service.version resource attribute. Defaults to the application version.

resourceAttributes.description: Additional resource attributes. service.name, service.version, and deployment.environment.name are set through their dedicated keys.
